name: ordered_selector_scan
summary: Selector 0 reads a count and compares listed bytes with runtime +3 (species id), then scans or skips nested 0x70 blocks. Selectors 1 and 2 scan until selector 3; other selectors consume only the selector byte.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; selector 0 compares and scans nested blocks; selectors 1/2 terminate at 0x70 selector 3

name: threshold_selector_gate
summary: Selector 0 compares operand byte 2 with signed runtime +3212 (signed threshold) and scans nested 0x71 blocks when the threshold condition fails. Selector 1 scans to selector 2; other selectors consume only the selector byte.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x71 selectors 1/2

name: global_guard_selector_gate
summary: Selector 0 is gated by globals at 0x1e8001ec+8, 0x1ed52870, and 0x1ed52951, then scans nested 0x72 blocks. Selector 1 scans to selector 2; other selectors consume only the selector byte.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x72 selectors 1/2

name: masked_runtime_selector_scan
summary: Selector 0 compares a list against runtime +2920 (target flag word) masked with 0x7f and clears the high-bit-preserving field on equality; selectors 1/2 scan nested 0x73 blocks to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; selector 0 may clear runtime +2920 bit mask

name: masked_runtime_threshold_gate
summary: Selector 0 reads operand byte 2 and compares it with runtime +2920 (target flag word) masked by 0x7f; a guarded helper may allow immediate continuation, otherwise nested 0x74 blocks are scanned. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x74 selectors 1/2

name: ordered_runtime_2930_scan
summary: Selector 0 compares listed bytes with runtime +2930 (0x75 comparison byte) and skips or scans nested 0x75 blocks; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x75 selector 3

name: global_flag_ordered_scan
summary: Selector 0 derives a comparison byte from bits at global 0x1e8001ec+2357, compares a list, and scans nested 0x76 blocks; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x76 selector 3

name: global_bit_gate
summary: Selector 0 continues only when global byte 0x1ed6bca0 has bit 0x10 set and bit 0x08 clear; selector 1 scans to selector 2. Other selectors consume only the selector byte.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminator is 0x77 selector 2

name: angle_interval_gate
summary: Selector 0 reads two bound bytes, computes the current angle from runtime +2068 (angle source) and +164, and conditionally scans nested 0x78 blocks. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; selector 0 accepts or skips a nested branch; nested terminators are 0x78 selectors 1/2

name: callback_result_ordered_scan
summary: Selector 0 calls the function pointer at runtime +1140 (behavior object pointer) offset +12 with operand byte 2, then compares its byte result with a counted list beginning at operand offset 4; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x79 selector 3

name: mapped_global_ordered_scan
summary: Selector 0 maps the global value at 0x1e7fff3c+52 through table 0x118648f0, compares mapped list values, and scans nested 0x7a blocks; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x7a selector 3

name: increment_runtime_1096
summary: Increments the word at runtime +1096 (script RNG counter) and consumes only the opcode byte.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1

name: mapped_global_gate
summary: Selector 0 maps the global value at 0x1e7fff3c+52 through 0x118648f0; mapped values 9, 10, 53, and 54 continue immediately, otherwise nested 0x7c blocks are scanned. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x7c selectors 1/2

name: actor_type_list_gate
summary: Selector 0 reads a count and candidate bytes, tests each with 0x1087cb30(runtime +3 (species id), candidate), and skips nested 0x7d blocks until a match; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x7d selector 3

name: candidate_lane_selection
summary: Runs a native candidate search. It resets runtime +2582 (command arg 1) and +2612, chooses a branch using native state, scans up to 40 records matching runtime +2040 (act/motion id) and other raw fields, and writes the selected record byte to runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target) and +2584.
control_flow: handler returns the incoming cursor; may retry the alternate branch once and returns when no candidate is found

name: bit_40_clear_gate
summary: Selector 0 clears bit 0x40 in runtime +1042 (entity status word) only when 0x1086a920 returns zero, then scans nested 0x7f blocks. Selector 1 clears the same bit and scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x7f selectors 1/2

name: bounded_nested_delta_scan
summary: Selector 0 reads a count and scans nested 0x80 records, accumulating signed deltas in their third byte against runtime +1096 (script RNG counter) masked to 5 bits. Nonzero selectors use a width/terminator scan; selector 0xff advances one byte.

operands.meaning: nested delta records begin after this byte

control_flow: handler returns a cursor after counted nested records or selector-0xff terminator

name: call_primary_subscript
summary: Calls root[1][index]. A stage-0 caller saves the continuation at +2552; a stage-1 caller tail-jumps without replacing it. Stores the index at +2577, sets stage +2580 to 1, and installs the selected cursor at +2652.
control_flow: primary subscript call or same-level tail jump

name: call_secondary_subscript
summary: Calls root[15 + group][index]. A stage-1 caller saves the continuation at +2556; a stage-2 caller tail-jumps without replacing it. Stores the index at +2578, sets stage +2580 to 2, and installs the selected cursor at +2652.
control_flow: secondary subscript call or same-level tail jump

name: lane_value_ordered_skip
summary: Selector 0 compares a counted list against a selected lane value (or a distance-derived value for runtime +3231 (saved command kind) == 13), writes that value to runtime +1112 (linked-actor pointer), stores a skip count at +2586, and skips that many nested records. Selectors 1-5 scan to selector 0xff.
control_flow: handler returns cursor after nested records; selector 0 may skip runtime +2586 records
domain_notes: +2740 = per-slot f32 candidate weight used to rank the selected slots

name: increment_runtime_1096
summary: Shares the inline increment path with 0x7b: increments the word at runtime +1096 (script RNG counter) and consumes only the opcode byte.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1

name: set_runtime_flag_40
summary: Sets bit 0x40 in the word at runtime +1042 (entity status word), consumes the opcode, and calls 0x113aaac0.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1
domain_notes: sub_113AAAC0 compares the actor position with the position of the object at +1100, dispatches on the relation code and resolves the contact through dword_1E80DB34

name: clear_runtime_flag_40
summary: Clears bit 0x40 in the word at runtime +1042 (entity status word) and consumes the opcode.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1

name: load_vector_triplet
summary: Uses operand byte 1 to index the table at 0x118c5784[10*(runtime +3 (species id))] and copies three floats into runtime +172 (position x)/+176/+180 and +1784/+1788/+1792.
control_flow: inline handler; returns cursor + 2
domain_notes: dword_118C5784 is a per-species pointer array (10 dwords per species); sub_10868210 copies the 12-byte entry selected by the operand into the actor position +172/+176/+180 and snapshots +1784/+1788/+1792

name: compute_angle_to_field_164
summary: Computes an unsigned 16-bit result from the vector at runtime +172 (position x) and stores it as a dword at runtime +164 (heading); consumes operand byte 1.
control_flow: inline handler; returns cursor + 2

name: consume_only
summary: Consumes the opcode byte without other observed work.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1

name: consume_only
summary: Consumes the opcode byte without other observed work.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 1

name: global_value_ordered_scan
summary: Selector 0 compares a counted list against global dword 0x11c6a7e8 and scans nested 0x94 blocks; selectors 1/2 scan to selector 3.
control_flow: handler returns a replacement cursor; nested terminator is 0x94 selector 3
domain_notes: dword_11C6A7E8 is a global selector id (initial value -1, cleared by the table selector sub_10860360); sub_108682B0 takes the first listed byte that equals it, else the first listed byte >= it

name: set_field_164_high_byte
summary: Stores operand byte 1 shifted left by 8 into dword runtime +164 (heading) and consumes two bytes total.
control_flow: inline; continue at cursor + 2

name: scaled_runtime_threshold_gate
summary: Selector 0 scales operand byte 2 by global float 0x119b5ef0 and runtime +2712 (hate accumulator 5), compares it with runtime +2700 (hate accumulator 2), and conditionally skips nested 0x9a blocks. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x9a selectors 1/2
domain_notes: dword_119B5EF0 is the f32 constant 0.01; sub_1086EAD0 multiplies the actor size field +3206 by it when scaling +184/+188/+192

name: selected_record_gate
summary: Selector 0 checks the selected record at runtime +1826 (record table pointer) against raw record flags, helpers, and record offset +1040, returning immediately when all predicates pass; otherwise it scans nested 0x9b blocks. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x9b selectors 1/2

name: action_context_distance_gate
summary: Selector 0 scales operand byte 2 by 100 and continues through the nested body only when runtime action fields +2581/+2582/+2584 and the distance between floats at +2856 and +1800 satisfy the observed predicates. Selector 1 scans to selector 2.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested terminators are 0x9c selectors 1/2
domain_notes: +2856 = y of the stored reference point (f32 x/y/z) consumed by the distance gates
